# Controls: type aliases, part 2

> Generated from the source doc comments. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `cargo run -p choscorui-api-docs --locked`. The [index](README.md) lists every item. Every example assumes `use choscorui::prelude::*;`.

## `Slider`

type alias in `choscorui::prelude::Slider`

```rust
pub type Slider = Configured<Slider>;
```

A slider that edits `value`. It covers `0..=100` with a step of 1 and
a page of 10 until `.range`, `.step`, and `.page` change them. A value
outside the bounds shows the nearest bound and reports a
`ViewError::Clamped`.

#### Examples

```rust
use choscorui_compose::view::{Cx, Slider, View};

struct Volume;

impl View for Volume {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let level = cx.state(40);
        Slider::new("Volume", level.binding()).range(0..=100).step(1).page(10)
    }
}
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `Slider::new`

```rust
pub fn new<M>(name: impl IntoLive<TextContent, M>, value: Binding<i32>) -> Self
```

A horizontal slider named `name` that edits `value`.

#### `Slider::page`

```rust
pub fn page(self, page: u32) -> Self
```

The change of one page key. A page of zero becomes 1 and
reports a `ViewError::Clamped`.

#### `Slider::range`

```rust
pub fn range(self, bounds: RangeInclusive<i32>) -> Self
```

The bounds of the value. Reversed bounds become
`start..=start` and report a
`ViewError::Clamped` when the
view mounts.

#### `Slider::step`

```rust
pub fn step(self, step: u32) -> Self
```

The change of one arrow key. A step of zero becomes 1 and
reports a `ViewError::Clamped`.

#### `Slider::vertical`

```rust
pub fn vertical<M>(name: impl IntoLive<TextContent, M>, value: Binding<i32>) -> Self
```

A slider whose thumb moves up and down.

## `SpinBox`

type alias in `choscorui::prelude::SpinBox`

```rust
pub type SpinBox = Configured<SpinBox>;
```

An integer field with steppers that edits `value`. Like [`Slider`](#slider), it
covers `0..=100` with a step of 1 and a page of 10 until `.range`,
`.step`, and `.page` change them.

```rust

    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let copies = cx.state(1);
        SpinBox::new("Copies", copies.binding()).range(1..=99)
    }
}
```

## `StackedContainer`

type alias in `choscorui::prelude::StackedContainer`

```rust
pub type StackedContainer = Configured<HostedStack>;
```

The semantics of a stack of `pages` pages, which shows page `current`.
It paints nothing: put it in a `ZStack` with the view of the current
page, as a `Tabs` view sits next to its panel. No pages report a build
error, and a page past the end keeps the page that it shows.

#### Examples

```rust
use choscorui_compose::view::{Cx, Dynamic, StackedContainer, Text, View, ZStack};

struct Wizard;

impl View for Wizard {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let step = cx.state(0_usize);
        ZStack::new((
            StackedContainer::new("Steps", 3, step),
            Dynamic::new(move || Text::new(format!("Step {}", step.get() + 1))),
        ))
    }
}
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `StackedContainer::new`

```rust
pub fn new<M, N>(name: impl IntoLive<TextContent, M>, pages: usize, current: impl IntoLive<usize, N>) -> Self
```

A stack named `name` with `pages` pages that shows page `current`.

## `Tabs`

type alias in `choscorui::prelude::Tabs`

```rust
pub type Tabs = Configured<HostedTabs>;
```

A tab list, one tab for each label; `selected` edits the chosen tab.
Show the chosen tab's content next to it. An empty list reports a
build error.

#### Examples

```rust
struct Pages;

impl View for Pages {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let tab = cx.state(0);
        let tabs = vec!["General".to_owned(), "Advanced".to_owned()];
        Tabs::new("Settings", tabs, tab.binding())
    }
}
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `Tabs::disabled_tab`

```rust
pub fn disabled_tab(self, index: usize) -> Self
```

Disables the tab at `index`. An index out of range, or the selected
tab, reports `ViewError::Clamped` and leaves every tab enabled.

#### `Tabs::new`

```rust
pub fn new<M>(name: impl IntoLive<TextContent, M>, tabs: impl Items<String>, selected: Binding<usize>) -> Self
```

A tab list named `name` with one tab for each label.

## `ToolBox`

type alias in `choscorui::prelude::ToolBox`

```rust
pub type ToolBox = Configured<ToolBox>;
```

Pages under stacked headers, with one page open; `open` edits the
index of the open page. Up and Down move between the headers, and
Space or Return opens one. The tool box paints the headers and leaves
the open page's area for the application.

#### Examples

```rust
use choscorui_compose::view::{Cx, ToolBox, View};

struct Settings;

impl View for Settings {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let open = cx.state(0_usize);
        ToolBox::new(vec!["General".to_owned(), "Advanced".to_owned()], open.binding())
    }
}
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `ToolBox::new`

```rust
pub fn new(titles: impl Items<String>, open: Binding<usize>) -> Self
```

A tool box with a page for each title, and `open` as the open page.

## `ToolButton`

type alias in `choscorui::prelude::ToolButton`

```rust
pub type ToolButton = Configured<HostedToolButton>;
```

A tool bar button that runs `action`. `.checked` makes it a toggle,
and `.menu` adds a menu; the button then reports `OpenChanged`.

#### Examples

```rust
use choscorui_compose::view::{Cx, ToolButton, View};

struct Format;

impl View for Format {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let bold = cx.state(false);
        ToolButton::new("Bold", || {}).checked(bold.binding())
    }
}
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `ToolButton::checked`

```rust
pub fn checked(self, checked: Binding<bool>) -> Self
```

Makes the button a toggle whose state `checked` edits.

#### `ToolButton::menu`

```rust
pub fn menu(self, menu: ToolButtonMenu) -> Self
```

Gives the button a menu: an instant menu opens on a press, and a
split menu opens from its arrow.

#### `ToolButton::new`

```rust
pub fn new<M>(label: impl IntoLive<TextContent, M>, action: impl Fn() + 'static) -> Self
```

A tool button with `label` that runs `action`.

## `Toolbar`

type alias in `choscorui::prelude::Toolbar`

```rust
pub type Toolbar = Configured<HostedToolbar>;
```

A row of command buttons on the `area` edge of a window, with one tab
stop and arrow keys between its items. Items that do not fit move to
a chevron menu. A command runs `.on_command`.

#### Examples

```rust
let items = vec![ToolbarItem::command("new", "New", CommandId(1))];
let toolbar = Toolbar::new("Main", ToolbarArea::Top, items)
    .on_command(|command| println!("run {command:?}"));
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `Toolbar::new`

```rust
pub fn new<M>(name: impl IntoLive<TextContent, M>, area: ToolbarArea, items: impl Items<ToolbarItem>) -> Self
```

A toolbar named `name` on the `area` edge with `items`.
